items.title: Noetherian approximation preserving geometric connectedness of the fibres
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a finitely presented morphism of affine schemes with geometrically connected fibres, the lemma produces a Noetherian approximation in which the approximating morphism again has geometrically connected fibres. The proof obtains the diagram from the general approximation lemma and then descends the geometric connectedness condition, using that it is a finite-presentation condition on the fibres. Descending the connectedness condition to the approximation is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 9923-9947.
